messages:
maya: Quick triage — we need to lock down what goes into the Optimize toolkit MVP for Q3. Customer asks piling up: batching heuristics, KV/prefix caching, quantization recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Can folks call out dev effort/risk and minimal launch criteria?
aj: For prioritization: batching + adaptive windowing is the clearest 1.0 win. Low infra risk, mostly runtime + config. Estimate: 3 sprints for core + 1 sprint for e2e tests.
sam: Caching (KV prefix cache) is medium complexity: requires runtime cache + eviction policy + metrics. Also needs cross-model validation for correctness. 4 sprints if scoped to same-model only; 6+ for cross-model / multi-tenant correctness.
lucia: From UX/console POV, we need simple toggles and perf previews. If we ship without previews, customers will toggle blind and cause regressions. Add a rollout preview + per-route delta charts. ~2 sprints.
maya: Noted. So minimal bundle could be: (A) batching heuristics + (B) per-model KV cache (same-model only) + (C) basic quantization guidance (not automated) + (D) eval-alert plumbing (alerts but no auto-rollbacks). Agree?
aj: Agree with that slice. On quant guidance: automated recommendation is high risk — quality regressions are subtle. We should ship a scoring rubric + recommended quant profiles per model size first. 1 sprint to produce recs for top 3 models.
neil: Customers asking for observability on quality impact. Eval-triggered alerts are high priority for enterprise. Need: threshold config, historical baseline, and easy mute/ack. If we only wire alerting but not baselines, it'll generate noise.
maya: Good point. Acceptance criteria proposal: 
- Perf: 20–30% cost/token reduction for batch-friendly workloads in lab tests
- Latency: median increase <= 10ms for single-request latency after batching
- Quality: no >2% drop on customer-specific evals for recommended quant profiles
- Alerting: configurable threshold + baseline computed over rolling 7d window and alert delivery to Slack/Email
sam: Implementation notes: need per-route sampling to run eval sets in prod (lightweight) and a retention policy for eval artifacts. Also need a rollout flag for cache/quant so we can canary.
lucia: Console mock snippet: 
Optimize > Batching
- Auto-batching: ON
- Batch window: 10ms (adaptive)
- Preview: predict 24% cost savings on current traffic
maya: We should also call out what we will NOT do in MVP to avoid scope creep: no automated quantization tuning, no cross-model cache sharing, no auto-rollback on alerts. We'll provide clear upgrade paths.
aj: Risks / blockers: kernel compatibility for quantized models on older GPUs — needs infra validation matrix. Also per-token cost calc changes when caching hits; accounting needs to be updated.
neil: Sales ask: early access customers want SLA language for latency and a playbook for when eval alerts fire (runbook). Can engineering commit to a basic runbook template?
sam: Yes, we'll draft a 1-page runbook: detection -> triage -> rollback -> owner contact. 1 sprint to draft alongside implementation.
maya: Action items: 
- aj: final effort estimates + infra validation matrix by EOD Wednesday
- sam: caching scope decision (same-model only vs cross-model) by Friday with perf baseline
- lucia: console preview mock + alert UX flows by next Tue
- neil: compile top 3 customer asks and their eval sets by Wed
- ops-bot: create recurring weekly triage meeting for Optimize toolkit (Wednesdays 10am)

ops-bot: Meeting created: #product • Optimize toolkit weekly triage — Wednesdays 10:00 AM • Organizer: maya
maya: Thanks — I'll synthesize into a short PRD and a proposed release gating checklist. Please drop any objections here. :thumbsup:
